usedFor: Acadle holds your learners and MSG91 sends the mail when “New User” runs “Send a Mail” from a template.

bestTemplate.name: “New User” in Acadle, then “Send a Mail” in MSG91
bestTemplate.why: A created user gets a templated mail, so onboarding starts without anyone typing it.

watchOut: “New User” in Acadle is polling, so “Send a Mail” goes out after the next scheduled check.
